location.description: Are the BAMs saved locally or on iRODs?

samplesheet.description: Comma-separated file containing the columns 'id', 'donor_id', 'bam', 'mutations', and 'snps'.

fasta.description: Fasta file for the genome build.

no_chr_prefix.description: Are the contigs prefaced with 'chr' (chr1) or without (1)?

vdj_bed.description: A bed file of the VDJ regions of interest.

ig_bed.description: A bed file of named IG regions (CSR, IGKC, IGLC1-7) whose coverage calls class switch recombination and light chain usage. If unset, the IG coverage step is skipped.

csr_max_norm_cov.description: Coverage of the CSR region below this fraction of the cell's overall mean coverage is called as class switch recombination.

light_chain_max_norm_cov.description: Coverage of IGKC below this fraction of the cell's overall mean coverage is called as deletion of the IGK locus, i.e. an IGL-using cell.

dnahyb_bed.description: A bed file of the bait set used for hybridisation.

baf_chrs.description: Any chromosomes of interest to zoom in on when making the BAF plots, for higher breakpoint resolution, delimited with a comma (e.g. 1,2,3).

baf_genes.description: Any genes of interest to mark when making the BAF plots, delimited with a comma (e.g. BRCA1,BRCA2).

refcds.description: Path to RefCDS Rda object from the dndscv package.

min_alt_vaf.description: Minimum alt VAF for a mutation to be reported in the genotyping report.

min_alt_depth.description: Minimum alt depth for a mutation to be reported in the genotyping report.

run_snps.description: Genotype SNPs and plot the BAFs?
